$comment: Context overflow recognition contract (context pipeline §8.6). Structured fields first; message regexes are family-scoped and only for HTTP 400. Patterns below are the initial set; Server selfHealPatterns may append more per family without a release. Cases without a source field use illustrative wording (shape and matching behaviour are what is locked). Clients also treat stopReason context_window_exceeded (Anthropic stream) as overflow — see stop-reason.v1.json.
rules: error.code == context_length_exceeded (any OpenAI-shaped family) -> overflow via code.
managed body code CONTEXT_LENGTH_EXCEEDED -> overflow via code; Free envelope code 40022 / data.reason free_context_length_exceeded -> overflow via code.
Anthropic: status 400 and error.type invalid_request_error and message matches patterns.anthropic -> type+regex.
Other families: status 400 and message matches patterns[family-group] -> status+regex. openai_chat / openai_responses / openai_compatible use patterns.openai_compatible.
Anything else is not overflow (429, 401, 5xx, other 400s).
Free overflow is a caller error: never MarkFailure / shouldAutoDisable* (AGENTS.md free-tier rule).

patterns.openai_compatible: (?i)(maximum context length|context length (is|of)|context window|exceeds? the (model'?s? )?(maximum )?context|prompt is too long|too many tokens in (the )?(prompt|input|messages)|exceeded model token limit|reduce the length of the (messages|prompt|input))
patterns.anthropic: (?i)(prompt is too long|input length and `?max_tokens`? exceed context limit)
patterns.gemini: (?i)(input token count.*exceeds the maximum number of tokens|exceeds the maximum number of tokens allowed)

patternSyntax: Case-insensitive; written in the common subset of ICU (Swift NSRegularExpression), java.util.regex and ECMAScript. Clients strip the leading (?i) and compile case-insensitively.
